seo.title: About RNC Landscaping | Local landscaper in Greater Victoria
seo.description: Meet RNC Landscaping: who runs it, how we work, our values and safety practice, and the credentials we hold. Serving Greater Victoria homes and stratas.

lede: A local contractor for grounds maintenance, landscape installation, irrigation and tree work across Greater Victoria, run by [OWNER NAME].

sections.heading: The people on your site
body: You deal with [OWNER NAME] from the first request to the final walkthrough. Crew size: [CREW SIZE].

items.title: Say what we'll do, then do it
items.body: A written scope, a clear schedule and no surprises.

items.title: Respect the property
items.body: We protect lawns, beds and structures, and clean up before we leave.

items.title: Respect the rules
items.body: We check watering rules and tree bylaws first, and point you to the source.

items.title: Be a good neighbour
items.body: We keep noise, parking and debris in mind on every street we work on.

sections.heading: How we work
body: Every job follows the same [site-first process](/process/): a site visit, a written scope, scheduled work and a review. We reply to every request within [REPLY TIME].

sections.heading: Safety
body: Safety comes before speed. Crews plan each job, use the right protective equipment and stop work when conditions are unsafe. WorkSafeBC: [WORKSAFEBC STATUS]. Insurance: [LIABILITY LIMIT].

sections.heading: Workmanship guarantee
body: Our workmanship guarantee covers [WARRANTY]. If something we installed or built does not hold up within that time because of how we did the work, tell us. We will come and look, explain in writing what we found, and put right anything that is our responsibility.

sections.heading: Work with us
body: See [our services](/services/), browse [sample projects](/projects/), or [get a free quote](/free-quote/).
